name: ui-soft-body-toggle
title: Soft Body Toggle
description: Bấm, núm bẹp ngang, chạy sang kéo dài như thạch, đập vào mép bên kia thì dẹt lại rồi nảy về tròn bằng lò xo; rãnh đổi màu theo.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Knob r17, track 104x48. Press (0-150 ms): scaleX 1.12, scaleY 0.85 (power2.out). Travel 52 px over 330 ms power2.inOut with a stretch scaleX + 0.4 × sin(π × progress). Arrival: squash scaleX 0.78 against the far edge (the knob keeps touching it), then back to 1 on a spring k420 d11; scaleY = 1 / scaleX; the track colour follows progress. Press at 0.4 s; reverse at 2.4 s. Params: press (0.15 s, 1.12 × 0.85) · travel (52 px, 0.33 s) · stretch (+0.4) · squash (0.78, k420 c11). Press: 1.12 × 0.85 in 0.15 s; travel with scaleX + 0.4 × sin(π progress); lands squashed to 0.78 against the far edge, then springs back; scaleY = 1 / scaleX.
